; छाया न मूर्छति मलोपहतप्रसादे शुद्धे तु दर्पणतले सुलभावकाशा Ś.7.32.
Dregs, refuse, sediment, excrement, feces, dung.

Any impure secretion of the body; (according to Manu these excretions are twelve: वसा शुक्रमसृङ् मज्जा मूत्रविड् घ्राणकर्णविट् । श्लेष्माश्रुदूषिका स्वेदो द्वादशैते नृणां मलाः
The three humours of the body (वात, पित्त and कफ). -लम् A kind of base metal.

athletic or gymnastic exercise.-घटी a kind of dance. -जम् black pepper. -नालः (in music) a kind of measure. -तूर्यम् a kind of drum.

मलयः [malayḥ], 1 N. of a mountain range in the south of India, abounding in sandal trees; (poets usually represent the breeze from the Malaya mountain as wafting the odour of sandal trees and other plants growing thereon, which peculiarly affects persons who are smit with love); स्तनाविव दिशस्तस्याः शैलौ मलयदर्दुरौ
N. of the country lying to the east of the Malaya range, Malabar.

(In music) A kind of measure. -Comp. -अचलः, -अद्रिः, -गिरिः, -पर्वतः &c. the Malaya mountain. -अनिलः, -वातः, -समीरः the wind blowing from the Malaya mountain, south-wind; ललितलवङ्गलतापरिशीलनकोमलमलयसमीरे
; cf. अपगतदाक्षिण्य दक्षिणानिलहतक पूर्णास्ते मनोरथाः कृतं कर्तव्यं वहेदानीं यथेष्टम् K.;
. -उद्भवम् sandal-wood. -जः a sandal tree; अयि मलयज महिमायं कस्य गिरामस्तु विषयस्ते
. (-जः, -जम्) sandal-wood. (-जम्) an epithet of Rāhu. ˚रजस्n. the dust of sandal. -द्रुमः a sandal tree. -वासिनी an epithet of Durgā.

मालाका [mālākā], f. A garland; L. D. B.

; यदा मेधाविनी शिष्योपदेशं मलिनयति तदाचार्यस्य दोषो ननु

N. of a demon, son of Suketu. [He was the maternal uncle and minister of Rāvaṇa and aided him in many of his schemes. In early times he propitiated the god Brahman by his austere penance, as a reward of which the splendid island of Laṅkā was caused to be built for him. He lived there with his brothers for some years, but afterwards left it, which was then occupied by Kubera. Afterwards when Rāvaṇa ousted Kubera from the island, Mālyavat returned with his relatives and lived with him for a long time.]
माल्लवी [māllavī], A wrestling or boxing match (also माल्लयात्रा).
